objective: Replace the 12 explicit affine colour states of one smooth C4 wire by an exact Fourier-domain formula suitable for a global non-enumerative contraction algorithm.
fourier_definition: For omega^3=1 and omega!=1, W_hat(k)=sum_{x in F3^6} W(x)*omega^(k dot x), where W is the indicator of the 12 wire states.

theorem.name: C4_WIRE_F3_FOURIER_TWO_LINEAR_FORM_IDENTITY
theorem.statement: Let sigma(k)=sum_i k_i, L_plus(k)=k dot v_plus and L_minus(k)=k dot v_minus in F3. If sigma(k)!=0 then W_hat(k)=0. If sigma(k)=0 then W_hat(k)=3*(h(L_plus(k))+h(L_minus(k))), where h(0)=2 and h(1)=h(2)=-1. Therefore the Fourier support is exactly the five-dimensional conservation hyperplane sigma=0, of size 3^5=243. On that hyperplane W_hat takes only the values 12, 3, -6: 12 when both L_plus=L_minus=0, 3 when exactly one vanishes, and -6 when neither vanishes.
proof: The 12 states are exactly x=c*1+s*v_q with c in F3, s in {1,2}, q in {+,-}; direct substitution in the v8.2 port formula gives v_plus and v_minus above, and the 12 tuples are distinct.
Hence W_hat(k)=sum_c omega^(c*sigma(k)) * sum_q sum_{s in {1,2}} omega^(s*L_q(k)).
The c-sum is 3 when sigma(k)=0 and 0 otherwise.
For t in F3, omega^t+omega^(2t) equals 2 for t=0 and -1 for t=1 or 2, giving h(t).

On sigma=0 the two linear forms L_plus,L_minus together with sigma have rank 3. Thus both-zero frequencies number 3^(6-3)=27. Each one-zero hyperplane inside sigma=0 has size 3^4=81, so exactly-one-zero frequencies number 2*(81-27)=108, leaving 243-27-108=108 with neither zero.

algorithmic_consequence.positive: The local 12-state wire enumeration collapses exactly to one conservation law plus two F3 linear forms. This is a strict algebraic compression of the local carrier and is compatible with exact holographic/flow formulations.
algorithmic_consequence.negative: Fourier support is not sparse beyond conservation: all 243 conserved frequencies survive. Therefore a solver cannot rely on local Fourier sparsity alone.
algorithmic_consequence.next_target: E8_V8_5_2_GLOBAL_BRANCH_SUM_COLLAPSE: derive an exact source-respecting global contraction of the two linear-form factors without expanding 2^m or 3^m local branches. Test whether the resulting invariant is a polynomial-time transition/interlace/rank evaluation; if not, prove the precise obstruction and pivot.

literature_context: Domain-3 Holant/holographic dichotomies establish genuine polynomial-time families after suitable basis transformations, motivating an exact transform test rather than heuristic gadget search.
Transition, Martin and interlace polynomials are natural exact state-sum invariants for 4-regular graphs and are the next global comparison class.
